恭喜母校創校二十五週年！
作為二零一五年的畢業生，我始終銘記着「態度決定高度」
這個信念。二十五歲的我，已踏入警察生涯第六年。這份態度不
僅推動我在工作中持續進步，也賦予我面對各種逆境的勇氣與韌
力——而這一切都深深受益於母校當年的栽培。
無論是中學時期課堂上的教誨，還是田徑場上鍛鍊出來的意志，都讓我在後來崎嶇的道路
上走得更加穩健、更加堅定。
衷心祝願母校繼續引領學子奮勇向前，開創無限未來！
It has been almost a year since I left the place I used to
call home. I have seen and been through a lot, and I have
won and lost a lot. Life has treated me well, but not well
enough for me to move on completely. Being far away from
home and the people I care about, I cannot help but think
about it every night. All the fun and laughter, and the time I spent with friends, come
back to me, and this busy, endless life only makes my sorrow even louder.
I try to speak from the heart, but words simply cannot describe my gratitude for
YYC. I have gained everything I could ever ask for: knowledge, friendship, and a bright
future. I wish I could go back in time and experience it all again, but life has only just
begun, and there is still more to see and learn. I will keep fighting my way to the end,
but I will never forget my beginnings, my backbone, and the reason I am here today. I
wish all the teachers I have met the very best. One day, I will bring you good news.
姓 名：梁紫軒
畢業年份：2015
現 職：警察
Name: Vinod Jackson ( 威龍杰克 )
Graduation Year: 2025
University Attended : Monash University
Undergraduate of Engineering Faculty
